!!! note "About the masses"
    Masses are the rounded values found on most classroom periodic tables,
    usually two decimal places. Elements with no stable isotope (Tc, Pm, and
    Po through Ac) use the mass number of a long-lived isotope. Elements beyond
    uranium are not included yet; see the [roadmap](project/roadmap.md).

## Get this data in Python

```python
from chemhelper import elements

elements.Fe.mass                 # one element
elements.elements["Fe"]          # the same Element, looked up by symbol
elements.element_table           # everything, as a pandas DataFrame
```

See the [elements guide](guide/elements.md) for everything you can do with it.
